entities.name: Dack Fayden
entities.description: A human planeswalker thief with psychometry from Drakeston on Fiora, protagonist of the IDW comics, who died in the War of the Spark when an Eternal harvested his spark.

entities.name: Marsh
entities.description: Dack's friend and rival at the magical academy, killed by a sword in a fight with ruffians.

entities.name: Mariel
entities.description: Dack's childhood friend whom he loved, murdered with the rest of Drakeston.

entities.name: Drakeston
entities.description: Dack's home town on Fiora, massacred by Sifa Grent.

entities.name: Fiora
entities.description: The plane where Drakeston lies.

entities.name: Sifa Grent
entities.description: A death mage planeswalker who murdered Drakeston and sought to drain Vitu-Ghazi; killed by Dack on Ravnica.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The guild city plane that became Dack's adopted home.

entities.name: Cult of Rakdos
entities.description: The Ravnican guild from which Dack stole a dagger and whom Sifa courted.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The gothic plane where Dack hunts Sifa and later searches for relics.

entities.name: Falkenrath
entities.description: Vampires of Innistrad whose enmity Dack gains.

entities.name: Ingrid Reichert
entities.description: A Cathar who ally Dack against Sifa.

entities.name: Hermann Reichert
entities.description: Ingrid's father, a Cathar who allies with Dack.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker who comes for the Ancient Fang and traded knowledge of Sifa for it.

entities.name: Malfegor
entities.description: A demon of Grixis who captures Dack hoping to steal his spark.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: The tiny world, before the conflux of Alara, where Dack is captured.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: The City Tree of Ravnica that Sifa plots to drain.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane where Dack takes a magical gauntlet and contracts the Sleep Curse.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: The Nightmare Weaver who caused the Sleep Curse.

entities.name: J'dashe
entities.description: An Orzhov pontiff who funded Dack's heists and returns as a ghost.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: Nicol Bolas' invasion of Ravnica in which Dack fights and dies.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The dragon planeswalker who invades Ravnica with the Dreadhorde and traps planeswalkers with the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: An artifact Bolas uses to trap planeswalkers on Ravnica, later disabled by Chandra and reactivated.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: A planeswalker artificer whom Dack flirts with.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A planeswalker whose bident Dack touches secretly.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who recommends splitting into teams.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A planeswalker who flies a micro-drone into Tezzeret's Bridge mechanism.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A planeswalker who goes through the Planar Bridge and later escapes.

entities.name: Samut
entities.description: A planeswalker who joins the mission to Amonkhet.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Bolas' servant with the Bridge control mechanism in his chest, who is defeated and planeswalks away.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet who gives the planeswalkers her spear and convinces Dack to return to battle.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A rogue planeswalker who arrives with Hazoret.

entities.name: Chandra
entities.description: A planeswalker who disables the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Gideon
entities.description: A planeswalker who suggests reactivating the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Atha
entities.description: A magic user in Meletis who tells Dack of the Sleep Curse.

events.summary: Dack and Marsh pick a fight with ruffians; Marsh is killed by a sword and Dack is struck down, and his spark flares.
events.quote: Lying smoldering next to the body of his friend, Dack’s spark flared and he ascended.

events.summary: Dack is beaten by a guardian Djinn on Alkabah while stealing an artifact and imprisoned, where his hand is stained red.
events.quote: The guardian Djinn beat him horribly and left him for the city guards.

events.summary: Dack returns to Drakeston to find the town massacred, including Mariel.
events.quote: the entire town having been murdered while he was away

events.summary: Dack steals a dagger from the Cult of Rakdos and learns it was held by Sifa Grent, who murdered Drakeston.
events.quote: he learned who was responsible for the deaths of everyone he had known. Her name was Sifa Grent .

events.summary: Dack goes to Innistrad and makes enemies of the Falkenrath vampires.
events.quote: He wasted no time in blundering directly into the vampires of the world, gaining the enmity of the Falkenrath in the process.

events.summary: Dack and Ingrid confront Sifa as she gathers a town; Dack drives her off but loses her.
events.quote: Dack drove Sifa and her minions away, but he lost her before he could exact his revenge.

events.summary: Sorin Markov freezes the Cathars in stasis and trades knowledge of Sifa for the dagger and their lives.
events.quote: He traded knowledge of Sifa for the dagger and the lives of the Cathars.

events.summary: Malfegor captures Dack on Grixis hoping to steal his spark, but Dack escapes.
events.quote: Before Malfegor could attempt his plan, though, Dack escaped

events.summary: Dack deduces Sifa plans to drain Vitu-Ghazi and fights her in the City Tree; one of his colleagues stabs her and Dack kills her with his most powerful spell.
events.quote: bringing vengeance upon the death mage at last

events.summary: Dack takes a magical gauntlet from the Boros Legion's Sunhome, travels to Theros, finds the other half and defeats a kraken.
events.quote: Fayden slipped on the completed gauntlet, felt an ancient power within him, and defeated the sea creature.

events.summary: Dack learns he will be affected by the Sleep Curse and enters Theros's Underworld.
events.quote: was last seen entering a portal to Theros's Underworld

events.summary: Dack is lured back to Ravnica by the Interplanar Beacon and trapped by the Immortal Sun, then fights the Dreadhorde.
events.quote: immediately became trapped there due to Bolas 's use of the Immortal Sun

events.summary: Dack touches Kiora's bident to copy its powers, but the attempt fails.
events.quote: He also managed to touch Kiora 's bident without her noticing

events.summary: Dack distracts Tezzeret so Karn can destroy the Bridge control mechanism, collapsing the portal.
events.quote: The portal collapsed, and the wounded Tezzeret revealed that he was glad they defeated him

events.summary: Hazoret convinces Dack to return to the battle on Ravnica, and he declines a second chance to escape.
events.quote: He was one of the few planeswalkers who chose to remain on Ravnica

events.summary: Surrounded by Eternals, Dack has his spark harvested and dies, thinking of Mariel.
events.quote: one of them managed to grab him by surprise and harvest his spark , killing him

relations.note: Sifa murdered the people of Drakeston, including Mariel
relations.quote: the planeswalker who had murdered the people of Drakeston
bringing vengeance upon the death mage at last

relations.note: childhood friend he was smitten with
relations.quote: he rediscovered his childhood friend Mariel , and as they grew close once again, he was smitten
befriended his biggest rival, a boy by the name of Marsh
a Cathar named Ingrid Reichert and her father Hermann Reichert
he had gained the attention of allies
he fought against the Eternals of Bolas' Dreadhorde

relations.note: owed J'dashe an enormous debt for funding his heists
relations.quote: he racked up an enormous debt to J'dashe
